data_policy: Wholly synthetic. No real people, employers, applicants or records.
notes: Expected labels are hand-authored (AI-assisted) proposals, review_status 'proposed'; none is human-adjudicated.
Recommendations and verifications added here are hand-written LABELS; no recommendation engine or verifier ran.
verification_*_lax records are deliberately mislabelled 'passed' so the reference recomputation can be exercised.
Cases are executed only by the TEST-ONLY conformance harness (tests/eval_harness.py): evidence tier T2.

Golden v2 (F3, RAP-F3-PLAN-2026-11-04 rev. 1.1): 24 cases are byte-identical copies of golden v1; only evalcase_g002 and evalcase_g008 are revised (version 2) so that each isolates exactly one unknown rule.
Golden v1 (evaluation-golden-v0.2.0-dev.json) is preserved unchanged. Runs against v1 and v2 are not comparable.

candidate_demo_g and its records are wholly synthetic and case-local (11 new case records in total: 9 non-label G records, the G label and the B-web label). g008's contested alternatives are two candidate statements from separate fields of one profile revision, not independent sources.

chunk_store.store/fixture/chunk_b_tampered: Synthetic summary: enjoys organizing small community events. [altered after indexing]
